findings.evidence: The definition at lines 139–141 quantifies over every positive `lambda`, whereas `roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/OneParameterSemigroups/README.md:142–153` states the milestone with `∃ l₀ > 0, Surjective (l₀ • 1 - A)`.
findings.fix: Define the range condition existentially (`∃ λ₀ > 0, Function.Surjective ...`), then prove that dissipativity upgrades it to surjectivity/bijectivity for every positive `λ`; alternatively provide and use an equivalence with that existential formulation.
findings.issue: `IsMDissipative` requires surjectivity of `λI-A` for every positive `λ`, while the natural Lumer–Phillips range condition only requires some positive `λ₀`; this makes future users prove a stronger hypothesis before invoking the API.

summary: `IsMDissipative` builds an unnecessarily universal range condition into the public definition, stronger than the standard and roadmap-level hypothesis.
